title: Canonical limiting tensor maps are P-linear from initial-stage compatibility
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, F:I→CommRingCat a ring diagram with colimit A, i₀≤i, and B₀ a commutative F(i₀)-algebra. Write B_j=F(j)⊗_{F(i₀)}B₀ and B=A⊗_{F(i₀)}B₀, and J={j | i≤j}. Let P be a commutative ring; fix P-algebra structures on B_i, B, and each B_j. Suppose μB:B_i→B and βs_j:B_i→B_j are P-algebra maps equal to the canonical tensor maps. Then there are P-algebra maps μ_j:B_j→B equal to the canonical tensor maps to the colimit. The underlying ring maps are the explicit tensor maps; no arbitrary witness is selected.

source.place: Tags 02JO (lemma-flat-finite-presentation-limit-flat), proof of (3), construction of Ψ; 00DD (lemma-tensor-product-colimit), canonical tensor legs. Online source read 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Define α_i:F(i)→A, α_j:F(j)→A, and α_ij:F(i)→F(j) using the functor and colimit maps. Colimit naturality gives α_j composed with α_ij equals α_i. Tensor-map composition and the canonical identities for μB and βs_j imply ρ_j composed with βs_j equals μB, where ρ_j is the actual canonical tensor ring map.

For p in P, use βs_j linearity to rewrite algebraMap P B_j p as βs_j(algebraMap P B_i p). The preceding composition identity and μB linearity show ρ_j maps this to algebraMap P B p. Equip ρ_j with this commutation proof to obtain μ_j. The required ring-map identity is reflexivity.

proof_origin.place: P-linearity of canonical tensor legs in the comparison-system construction, proved by explicit AlgHom construction. Second reading: direct Mathlib tensor-map composition and tensor induction are elementary identities, not applications of the tensor pushout universal-property node.

theorem exists_comparison_tensor_canonical_maps
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) [HasColimit F]
    (i₀ : I) (B₀ : Type w) [CommRing B₀] [Algebra (F.obj i₀) B₀]
    (P : Type y) [CommRing P]
    (aP : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (i : I) (hi : i₀ ≤ i)
    (aPi : letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (μB : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPi
      letI := aP
      (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P] (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (hμB : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      let αi : F.obj i →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
        { (colimit.ι F i).hom with
          commutes' := fun s ↦
            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s) (colimit.w F (homOfLE hi)) }
      μB.toRingHom =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αi (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom)
    (aPs : ∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
          letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
          Algebra P (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (βs : ∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aPi
                    letI := aPs j
                    (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
                      (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (hβs : (∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let αij : F.obj i →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj j.val :=
                      { (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom with
                        commutes' := fun s ↦
                          congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj j.val ↦ f s)
                            (F.map_comp (homOfLE hi) (homOfLE j.property)).symm }
                    (βs j).toRingHom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αij (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom)) :
      let J := {j : I // i ≤ j}
                  ∃ (μs : ∀ j : J,
                    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aPs j
                    letI := aP
                    (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
                      (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
                  (∀ j : J,
                    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let αj : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
                      { (colimit.ι F j.val).hom with
                        commutes' := fun s ↦
                          congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s)
                            (colimit.w F (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))) }
                    (μs j).toRingHom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αj (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom)
